experiment: native-runtime-v3: failure groups, lossless search index, contextual recovery, task profiles; findings-preserving, low-overhead skill

manifest.order: odd pairs: requested arm order; even pairs: reverse order; tasks in requested order
manifest.isolation: temporary cwd/config; no MCP/context/discovered skills/templates/themes; explicit silent startup observer in all arms; runtime hook and recovery only in runtime/both; four built-in tools plus recovery tool in runtime/both
manifest.runtime_policy: explicit profile (auto; auto = review task -> review, others -> implementation), fresh local recovery store per run

processor_replay.method: Identical synthetic text processed with default policy, 10 repeats per fixture; per-fixture evidence assertions (distinct failure groups, lossless search index, summaries), exact full-storage and line-range recovery assertions. No model calls.
processor_replay.limitation: UTF-8 bytes and local processor latency only, not tokens, E2E task performance, or billed cost. Evidence assertions are fixture-specific; recovery reads are excluded from processor latency.

definitions.savings: 100 * (baseline sum - laconic sum) / baseline sum; negative means increase
definitions.total_tokens: input + output + cacheRead + cacheWrite summed once per completed assistant message; reasoning is already output
definitions.estimated_cost_usd: sum of Pi usage.cost.total metadata; catalog-based estimate, not billed/subscription cost
definitions.input_context: input + cacheRead + cacheWrite; repeated context counted as the provider reports it
definitions.words: regex word count; prose includes all assistant text, not reasoning/code tool arguments
definitions.tool_bytes: UTF-8 text content bytes; excludes envelopes, images and tool-call arguments; not token counts
definitions.review_found: seeded review defects matched by file + keyword in findings.json (independent, hidden from the agent)
definitions.recovery_bytes: UTF-8 bytes returned by laconic_read_result calls
definitions.tool_efficiency: independent acceptance checks passed / tool-result bytes * 1000; meaningful only for this identical task
definitions.artifact_policy: non-streaming message_end events; reasoning/signatures omitted, temporary paths replaced
definitions.change_vs_baseline_percent: 100 * (arm sum - baseline sum) / baseline sum; negative means reduction

publication: Aggregate, per-task and paired measurements only; scripts, raw sessions, generated solutions and recovery stores remain local.
